title: David Greaves Says ‘Once Upon a Time in Harlem’ Is “An Act of Resistance” Against Efforts to Erase Black History
summary: When William Greaves died before completing his Harlem Renaissance documentary, his son David, who had helped to shoot it but had never directed a feature film of his own, stepped in to finish it: "I couldn't imagine anybody else doing it," he tells The Hollywood Reporter.
tags: Once Upon a Time in Harlem
